intro: Melithar Staghelm is a night elf stationed just outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Teldrassil's starting glade. He assists young night elf adventurers as they embark on their early training, sending them to nearby instructors and addressing minor local disturbances. While he shares the prominent Staghelm surname with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, his exact connection to the ruling druid remains unconfirmed.

p: Standing directly outside the entrance to the great bough of Aldrassil, Melithar serves as an early point of contact for night elves emerging into the world. He directs newly awakened youth bearing various sigils to their respective class trainers, ensuring they receive proper tutelage in the martial and mystical arts. Beyond administrative guidance, Melithar watches over the immediate grounds of Shadowglen, enlisting help to deal with mischievous local wildlife and minor impish intrusions that threaten the sanctuary's peace.

Bearing the surname Staghelm inevitably draws attention, as Archdruid Fandral Staghelm currently leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus following Malfurion Stormrage's disappearance into the Emerald Dream. However, Melithar makes no outward boast of grand heritage, nor does he actively speak of his lineage. Whether he is a distant kinsman of the Archdruid's venerable family line or merely shares an ancient Kaldorei family name, Melithar remains content fulfilling humble duties at the roots of Aldrassil.
